text: Boundary: runtime-neutral Neuropublish v1 records, digest codecs, parcel restore and validation move into neuroatlas4s-core without image/surface dependencies; concrete volume grid publication, realization, query, reduction, overlap/adjacency and template catalog/bridge policy move into optional volumeJVM/JS; JVM catalog/asset and transform readers into optional volumeIoJVM. Mixed/surface graph and concrete surface realization remain downstream, importing the shared metadata and validators. Volume routes compose existing neuroim4s VolumeGraph/ProviderMapBinding; no new route-search or interpolation kernel. The portable frozen atlas parity corpus and loader/NIfTI tests move upstream, while mixed surface and native oracle consumers remain downstream as witnesses. Keep all persisted org.scalafim identifiers and existing cache location unchanged. Acceptance includes wrong live-owner admission, route order/inverse refusal, background/unknown labels and display order, masked/custom reductions, native asset hashes/provenance and full compile. This is local coordinated development; publication remains separate.
